card.name: The word patch in application steps
card.fires_on: The word patch (or tablet) as the object of apply, put on or take, in step-by-step use instructions. It also fires weakly on attach or tie-on steps, such as in fly-tying.

modes.label: Patch as object
modes.description: The noun patch or tablet right after a verb or article in instructions for applying or taking it.
modes.example: she should apply a new<< patch>> immediately.

modes.label: Attach steps
modes.description: Words in assembly or attaching instructions, such as so, according or tie.
modes.example: attach a vented vial adapter<< according>> to manufacturer's instructions.
